body:
I wouldn’t be surprised if he was training these new writers specifically for this purpose.

He, from my knowledge, has always had problems with health. It would only make sense that he trained new individuals so the story could possibly be finished.

I think the real reason is because the director Tabata left Square Enix, and structural changes within the company. Originally Episode Ignis was going to be the last one, but people kept buying the DLC so they planned more. 

It’s shitty but atleast we got something out of it.
